title: Build: Fix `ejslint` execution path in lint-staged
body: Related Issues #33433 ## What I did Updated the `lint-staged` configuration for `.ejs` files. Previously, the configuration relied on a hardcoded physical path (`../scripts/node_modules/.bin/ejslint`), which caused failures in the development environment depending on Yarn's dependency hoisting strategy (e.g., when dependencies are hoisted to the root or when using PnP). I replaced the hardcoded path with `yarn --cwd ../scripts ejslint`. This leverages Yarn's resolution mechanism to reliably locate and execute the `ejslint` binary regardless of the underlying directory structure. ## Checklist for Contributors ### Testing This is an internal tooling fix, so no automated tests are applicable. #### Manual testing 1. Navigate to any directory containing `.ejs` files (e.g., `code/lib/cli/src/automigrate/templates`). 2. Make a trivial change to an `.ejs` file (e.g., add a whitespace). 3. Stage the file: `git add `. 4. Run `yarn lint-staged` manually in the root, or attempt to commit via `git commit`. 5. Verify that `ejslint` runs successfully without throwing a "No such file or directory" error regarding the executable path. ### Documentation Internal build script change, no documentation update required. ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Chores** * Updated linting configuration to streamline EJS file linting via project scripts, improving consistency of lint runs. ✏️ Tip: You can customize this high-level summary in your review settings.

**This command will fail to find .ejs files because of path resolution issues.**

The change assumes lint-staged can invoke a command from a different working directory without path adjustment. However, lint-staged passes file paths relative to the `code/` directory (where it runs), but `yarn --cwd ../scripts ejslint` executes from `scripts/`, causing path mismatches. For example, lint-staged passes `builders/builder-webpack5/templates/preview.ejs`, but ejslint running from `scripts/` will look for `scripts/builders/builder-webpack5/templates/preview.ejs`, which doesn't exist.

Either use absolute paths, run the command from `code/`, or adjust how file arguments are passed to ejslint so they resolve correctly from the `scripts/` directory.
